name: Octree Neighbor Finding
definition: Given an origin node and a coordinate direction to a desired destination node, neighbor-finding entails recursion up the octree until we find a parent containing both nodes.
summary: Octree Neighbor Finding locates adjacent leaf nodes in a Sparse Voxel Octree by finding the nearest shared ancestor and performing point location, distinguishing itself from Morton key methods by using explicit parent-pointer traversal and coordinate bit-masking.
